slots.image_prompt: A minimalist Japanese-style abstract ink wash landscape with soft warm brown and coffee-toned mountain silhouettes, rendered in gentle wash gradients. Vast empty space with cream-colored neutral background, a few delicate flowing curves suggesting distant rivers and waterways in muted earth tones. Soft paper texture, serene and contemplative mood, evoking the feeling of tracing a river to its source. No text, no characters, pure atmospheric decoration suitable for a book cover. Warm, quiet, meditative aesthetic with subtle ink diffusion effects.

An abstract minimalist line illustration of a single thin river flowing diagonally from the upper right to lower left, rendered in warm brown ink strokes with subtle variations in thickness. The line gently branches and converges, suggesting a river source splitting into tributaries. Set against a cream-colored warm neutral background with generous whitespace. Japanese Muji aesthetic, calm and meditative, no text or labels, purely atmospheric and symbolic of a river origin and flow.

Vertical abstract composition suggesting flowing streams of light and energy, rendered as soft warm brown vertical lines and gentle curves in earth tones. The lines vary in density and opacity, creating a sense of upward flow and temporal progression like a river of information ascending. Set against a cream-colored background with generous negative space. Japanese minimalist aesthetic, warm and organic, evoking the feeling of code and ideas flowing upstream toward their origin. No text, no numbers, purely decorative vertical accent element.

A dual-composition abstract illustration divided by a subtle central axis. On the left, warm brown flowing lines descend and cluster heavily at the bottom, suggesting weight, stagnation, and downward pull in muted dark earth tones. On the right, the same lines rise upward and disperse gracefully toward the top, suggesting liberation, growth, and return to source in lighter warm gold accents. Cream-colored background with generous whitespace. Japanese minimalist aesthetic, conceptual metaphor of transformation from stagnation to ascent, no text or labels.

An abstract minimalist composition featuring soft warm brown geometric shapes suggesting an upward ascending movement, rendered in muted earth tones with warm gold accents. The shapes are abstract and organic rather than literal arrows, composed of layered translucent planes and thin flowing lines converging upward. Set against a cream-colored background with generous Japanese-style negative space. Calm, contemplative, modern minimalist aesthetic suitable for a philosophy section divider. No text, no characters, purely atmospheric decoration.

An abstract minimalist radial composition with warm brown light rays emanating from a soft central point, spreading outward in gentle arcs and thin lines across the frame. The rays are rendered in layered warm earth tones with varying opacity, creating a sense of diffusion and influence radiating from a core. Set against a cream-colored background with Japanese-style negative space. Calm, warm, and contemplative mood, symbolic of knowledge and ideas spreading outward from a central source to reach many. No text, no human figures, purely atmospheric metaphor.

An abstract minimalist illustration of an open book suggested by gentle curved planes and soft warm brown shapes, rendered in muted earth tones with warm gold page-edge accents. The book form is implied rather than literal, composed of flowing organic lines and translucent layered planes evoking open pages resting flat. Set against a cream-colored background with generous Japanese-style whitespace. Serene, contemplative, quiet atmosphere suitable for a reading-themed section header. No text, no characters, purely atmospheric decoration.

A serene minimalist full-frame composition in warm earth tones, dominated by a cream-colored neutral background with gentle gradients of warm brown at the edges creating a soft vignette effect. A single thin horizontal warm gold line sits near the bottom third of the frame, serving as a quiet visual anchor and closure. Vast empty space above, evoking finality and contemplation. Japanese Muji aesthetic, peaceful and meditative, suitable as a closing slide background. No text, no elements, purely atmospheric.
